Other entities such as Functions, Types, or Namespaces are reached indirectly through their File containers (e.g., Project → File → Type → Function). Configuration files like .csproj, package.json, or pyproject.toml are not represented as File nodes. Their parsed metadata is instead stored within attributes (config_metadata, build_properties, and dependencies). This node allows for questions such as “What files belong to this project?”, “What is the target framework?”, or “What dependencies are declared?” — supporting structural and metadata-level project analysis.
